ARC Raiders delivers exciting action, a stylish world, and incredibly immersive presentation. The sound and graphics are standout features—crisp audio, beautiful environments, and smooth performance that pulls you right into the fight. It’s fast, fun, and consistently engaging. This game is great! and I have had a lot of fun playing it. However, there are a few problems that I found. First, there are many players camping at extraction points. Spending time looting just for someone to kill you at just before you leave. Second, the free loadout for players. There is no point in this. This game is a looter shooter, giving away free loadouts just encourages campers for a win/win situation. Third, there is no feeling of progress. I think this is for the fear of losing the good loadout, so you stick to using the basic stuff. 
In my opinion, those are the most important points that need to be dealt with.

The PvP makes the game frustrating, but without the PvP the game would be boring.

The majority of the game is fun and open world. PVP is a natural part of the process. What isn't as popular is the prospect of much higher level players with far better gear, guns, quick items, and shields hiding at extraction points or important locations trying to kill you and take all your stuff.

You might spend over 20 minutes trying to scavenge as much as you can, or to kill that super tough enemy, only to be killed by said players. It is so rampant, they have earned the nickname 'rats'. The game do not have a level separation mechanic, or a penalty for targeting weaker players, so it is the game's fault as much as the player's fault.

The game does have a 'free loadout' option, that equips you with random level 1 weapons and items. But if you lost epic or legendary items to one of these rats, the free load out doesn't seem much of a compensation.

I am having a fun time with this game. I enjoy extraction PvPvE shooters, so I am more predisposed to like this style of game. That being said, I think that Embark Studios has figured out a fun gameplay loop with balanced gun play. The word that keeps coming to mind is accessible. This is not Tarkov, Hunt Showdown, or Marauders. This is a very forgiving and visually stunning game. 

If you like lore, it has lore. If you like action, it has action. If you like sweaty, thrilling, gun fights that last half an hour, it doesn't really have that. Go to another hardcore extraction shooter. But if you want a fun extraction shooter that doesn't take itself too seriously, that gives you a pet chicken to collect loot for you, this might be the game for you.
Imagine tarkov, but 3-rd person, and more relaxed.
